coordinate_contract.note: The simulation is binary. A/C are deterministic VCF encodings of tree-sequence states 0/1, not inferred nucleotide identities.

reference_pairing.rule: Sort REF_LAI node IDs within ancestry and pair consecutive haplotypes into phased pseudodiploids.
reference_pairing.reason: M28 allocates independent haplotypes; Gnomix consumes diploid phased VCF samples. Pairing within ancestry preserves every selected haplotype exactly once.

marker_selection_inputs: REF_LAI support already frozen by M28B-v4
forbidden_inputs: M28 TARGET genotypes for marker selection
access_boundary.truth_opening: The merged m28_lai_truth table remains unopened. The isolated constructor reads generative mosaic events to copy donor haplotypes; ancestry is reconstructible there but is not used for marker selection, model fitting or parameter choice.

gates.I0_HASHES: All four authenticated inputs match the preregistered SHA-256 values.
gates.I1_B0_CARDINALITY: The frozen B0 table contains exactly 79791 unique, ordered sites and every site is materialized.
gates.I2_ROLE_BOUNDARY: Reference genotypes use REF_LAI only; every target segment uses a unique DONOR node whose pool ancestry matches the event ancestry.
gates.I3_REFERENCE: Exactly 60 phased REF_LAI haplotypes per ancestry become 30 pseudodiploids per ancestry without reuse.
gates.I4_TARGET: Exactly 60 target haplotypes become 30 phased diploids; every mosaic covers the full simulated interval without gaps or overlaps.
gates.I5_INTERNAL_VCF: A second parser confirms identical ordered positions, no missing calls and valid phased diploid genotypes in reference and target VCFs.
gates.I6_SCOPE: The merged truth table, LAI model, BR/BS features and effect metrics are not read or produced; generative events are isolated to genotype reconstruction.

gnomix_source.note: This preflight does not execute Gnomix. A separate gate must validate BGZF, Tabix and the exact Gnomix loader before training.
